about: Files that advance.mjs --snapshot / --replace-root may publish although snapshot-scan.mjs flags them: obviously fake fixtures, public third-party author addresses, pinned evidence that names a local path, and the scanners' own rule text. An entry covers only these exact bytes (sha256) and only the listed rules; a changed byte or a new rule refuses again. A snapshot that changes this file says so in the popup.
